Subject: Pilot expansion — additional onboarding access for StudyHub consortium

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team found the latency profile and prompt-sharding suggestions very promising. We registered StudyHub Consortium through your PLG flow and have a handful of teams that started trying the hosted API.

We’re asking whether Redwood can provision an additional onboarding credit pool and extend the initial free trial window by two weeks for our consortium pilot. The usage is concentrated on education-focused evaluation workloads (short chat sessions and embeddings for search).

Attached is a short onboarding plan and a rough usage estimate. If there’s a self-serve redemption path, point us there and we’ll have our platform admin complete it. If you need any internal approvals or a PO, please let me know — we’re hopeful this will become a wider procurement next quarter.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Research Programs
StudyHub Consortium

Hi Lena — great to hear the demo landed well. Thanks for the attachments; I skimmed the plan and the usage table.

Short answers:
- We do have a self-serve academic credit issuance flow for consortiums like yours (no PO required for initial pilot top-ups).
- For a two-week trial extension and the credit pool you outlined, I can provision up to $5k in onboarding credits today pending an internal quick approval.

Next steps from our side: I’ll kick off an approval note with our EDU credit team (looping Marissa) and return with a redemption link you can use. If you prefer immediate access, we can also create a single-use promo code for your admin account.

Can you confirm the email address for your platform admin who will redeem the credits? Also confirm whether the teams need embeddings quota prioritized — that affects which model variants we recommend.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions — Redwood Inference

---
Tessa Morgan

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Lena’s request and the attached plan. Enrollment looks like the standard academic consortium scenario (nonprofit; multi-team pilot). They’ve asked for a two-week extension + $5k credits to cover embeddings and short chat workloads.

Quick context: this came via PLG signup; they’re already using the hosted API under trial. I recommend:
- Approve the $5k onboarding credit and 14-day trial extension (auto-expiry).
- Issue a single-use promo code tied to StudyHub admin email and set embeddings quota to 60% of credit consumption for first 30 days.

Risks/notes: they’ll likely convert to a dedicated capacity evaluation by Q4. No custom SLA yet. No unusual security requirements beyond standard EDU attestation.

If you’re good with this, can one of you (Marissa preferably for EDU credits) greenlight and I’ll create the promo code and email Lena with redemption instructions.

Thanks,
Tessa
